purpose: Hypothetical Irish Nasdaq-100 after-tax research with a curated current study
broker_execution: none; simulations use cached public market research inputs
contents: Source, cached market research inputs and provenance, one current report, three leading stock strategies, three underperforming variants, ETF and stock baselines, matched controls and independent audits
financial_scenarios: All contribution amounts, tax bands, portfolio values and trades are hypothetical model parameters or simulated outputs, not personal account or income information
exclusions: Personal account exports and account-authenticated API check artifacts

source_snapshots.included_as: Five reference modules verified byte-for-byte at this revision; local filenames differ; MIT licence and QuantNet LLC copyright retained in historical/prices/LICENSE.quantiacs
ordinary source snapshot; nested Git history excluded; original notices retained
ordinary source snapshot; nested Git history excluded; original notices retained

release_history: The public release is prepared from a sanitized working-tree snapshot; the original private Git history is excluded
data_integrity: Git line-ending conversion is disabled so recorded source-file hashes remain meaningful.
git_history: Public commits use the owner's GitHub username and no-reply email for contribution attribution without exposing a personal email; original private Git history is not included
result_selection: Three leaders and three weakest active gain-harvesting variants selected retrospectively from earlier studies; fourteen stock replays include matched controls and two exemption-unavailable sensitivities
data_cutoff: 2026-09-30 fixed sixteen-year study; benchmark source cache through 2026-10-02
historical_outputs: Superseded generated studies are removed from the current tree; prior public commits preserve the research history
